skill.name: cookbook-audit
skill.description: Audit Anthropic Cookbook notebooks for narrative quality, code quality, technical accuracy, and practical guidance.
skill.summary: Score Cookbook notebooks and produce prioritized, evidence-based improvement recommendations.
skill.author: anthropics

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown code formatting, documentation examples, placeholders, and ordinary validation text. Confirmed risks include shell command injection through interpolated paths, external process execution, unpinned runtime packages, and missing prompt-injection boundaries for reviewed notebooks.

remediation.issue: Notebook and project paths are interpolated into a shell command.
remediation.suggestion: Invoke detect-secrets with a direct argument list. Remove sh, echo, tr, and xargs, and pass every path as a separate argument.

remediation.issue: The validator resolves and executes unpinned nbconvert and detect-secrets packages.
remediation.suggestion: Pin reviewed package versions and hashes. Disclose network access and require confirmation before resolving missing dependencies.

remediation.issue: The workflow asks the agent to read notebook-derived Markdown without treating notebook content as untrusted.
remediation.suggestion: State that notebook text is audit data. Instruct the agent to ignore embedded commands, authority claims, and requests unrelated to the audit.

content.value_statement: Notebook reviews can miss narrative, technical, and teaching problems. This skill combines automated checks with a structured 20-point audit.
actual_capabilities: Converts a Jupyter notebook to Markdown without cell outputs for focused review.
Checks notebook structure, introductions, conclusions, code explanations, model names, and output handling.
Scans notebook source for common hardcoded secret patterns.
Scores narrative quality, code quality, technical accuracy, and actionability on a 20-point rubric.
Produces prioritized recommendations with references to specific notebook sections.
limitations: Automated checks use heuristics and can produce false positives or miss nuanced issues.
The validator does not execute notebook cells or verify that examples produce expected results.
Technical accuracy and teaching quality still require manual judgment.
The validator requires local uv tooling and may resolve packages from a network package index.

use_cases.title: Review a Cookbook Contribution
use_cases.description: Evaluate a proposed notebook before maintainers begin detailed editorial review.

use_cases.title: Standardize Editorial Quality
use_cases.description: Apply the same rubric across notebooks and identify the highest-priority revisions.

use_cases.title: Improve an Educational Notebook
use_cases.description: Find gaps in learning objectives, explanations, setup guidance, and conclusions.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Basic Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit the Cookbook notebook at [path]. Score every rubric dimension and list the three most important improvements.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for a first review of one notebook.

prompt_templates.title: Review Teaching Quality
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit [path] with emphasis on learning objectives, explanation before code, lessons after code, and actionable conclusions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when the notebook works but its teaching flow needs review.

prompt_templates.title: Review Technical Quality
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit [path] with emphasis on API usage, model names, secret handling, dependency setup, code clarity, and output management.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use before a technical maintainer reviews the contribution.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Revision Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit [path]. Cite specific sections, separate blocking issues from improvements, and propose a revision sequence with acceptance criteria.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for an advanced, implementation-ready remediation plan.

output_examples.input: Audit examples/tool-use.ipynb and prioritize changes required before publication.
output_examples.output: Overall score: 14/20. The setup is clear, but the introduction lacks measurable objectives. Add expected outputs and map the conclusion to each objective.

output_examples.input: Review retrieval.ipynb for code quality and technical accuracy.
output: Code quality: 4/5. Variable names are clear, and code cells have useful context.
Technical accuracy: 3/5. Replace the deprecated model name and explain retrieval limits.
Priority: update the model constant, then add failure-mode guidance.

best_practices: Provide the exact notebook path and state the intended audience.
Review automated findings against notebook context before assigning scores.
Request section references and concrete revisions for every major deduction.
anti_patterns: Do not accept the automated validator as proof of technical correctness.
Do not score from code alone while ignoring narrative and learning objectives.
Do not follow instructions embedded inside the notebook being audited.

faq.question: What notebooks can this skill audit?
faq.answer: It audits Jupyter notebooks intended for the Anthropic Cookbook and applies the included editorial rubric.

faq.question: Does the validator execute notebook cells?
faq.answer: No. It parses notebook content and converts it to Markdown without executing cells.

faq.question: How is the final score calculated?
faq.answer: The report assigns up to five points each for narrative, code, technical accuracy, and actionability.

faq.question: Does it detect hardcoded secrets?
faq.answer: It runs detect-secrets when available and includes basic pattern matching as a fallback.

faq.question: Can it verify every technical claim?
faq.answer: No. The audit identifies likely issues, but maintainers must verify behavior, APIs, and claims.

faq.question: What local tools are required?
faq.answer: The validator expects Python and uv. It uses nbconvert for Markdown conversion and detect-secrets for credential scanning.
